seoTitle: Case converter: upper, lower, title case
description: Change text to upper case, lower case, title case or sentence case, or camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case. Free, and your text stays on the page.

specs.Title case: Keeps small words like of, the and and lower case
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. It's converted in this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Which words stay lower case in title case?
faq.a: Short joining words such as a, an, and, of, the, to and in, unless they start the text.

faq.q: What happens to numbers and emoji?
faq.a: Numbers and emoji stay as they are in the plain cases, such as UPPER CASE and Title Case. The code styles, such as camelCase and snake_case, drop emoji and punctuation and keep the numbers.
